body.problem_statement: The TodoList component calls .map() on the todos prop without guarding against undefined or an empty array, causing a TypeError crash for any user with no todos.
body.summary: Add a null/empty check to the TodoList component so users with no todos see an empty state message instead of a crash.
body.current_behavior: Navigating to /todos when the user has no todos throws: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map'). The page crashes and shows a blank error screen.
body.expected_behavior: When the user has no todos, the /todos page renders: 'No todos yet. Create your first one!'
body.user_impact: All users with empty todo lists are unable to use the todos page.
body.business_impact: New users hit this on first login — the first experience after sign-up is a crash.
scope_in: Add null/empty guard to TodoList component
Render empty state message when todos is undefined or empty
scope_out: Fixing how the parent fetches or passes todos
constraints: Empty state text must match: 'No todos yet. Create your first one!'

acceptance_criteria.statement: Navigating to /todos with an empty or undefined todos list renders 'No todos yet. Create your first one!' without throwing an error.
acceptance_criteria.verification_hint: Render TodoList with todos={undefined} and todos={[]} — both must show the empty state message.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Navigating to /todos with one or more todos renders the list correctly.

assumptions: The component receiving undefined todos is TodoList in src/components/TodoList.jsx
The empty state message text is fixed as specified
